Analytics Engineer

 Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space—we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

 The role

As an Analytics Engineer in the Data Infrastructure Team at Prolific, you’ll be at the forefront of transforming and maintaining Prolific’s data infrastructure as the way people work with data changes rapidly. Your work will be instrumental in redesigning and scaling our data stack, ensuring data pipelines are robust, efficient, and reliable, and that our data is ready to be queried by people and AI systems alike. 

By owning and optimising our analytics codebase and semantic layer, you’ll empower teams across the business to get trustworthy answers, whether through BI dashboards or natural language questions. You’ll help shape how we bring LLMs and agents into analytics engineering safely and effectively, and you’ll bridge the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders so that complex data solutions are clearly understood and aligned with business goals.

What you’ll bring to the role

- Expertise in dbt & SQL: Deep experience with dbt and SQL to design, build, and maintain scalable data models.

- Semantic Modelling: Experience defining metrics, entities, and business logic in a semantic layer (e.g. dbt Semantic Layer/MetricFlow, Cube, LookML or similar), with an understanding of what makes a model reliable for natural language querying.

- Applied AI in Data Workflows: Hands-on experience using LLMs in data work, such as classification, extraction, or enrichment within transformations, and an understanding of how to evaluate, test, and govern outputs that aren’t fully deterministic.

- Agentic Tooling: Familiarity with AI coding assistants and agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling) and a practical view on where they speed up analytics engineering and where human review is essential.

- Cloud Technology Knowledge: Strong familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP.

- Data Accuracy Focus: Passion for ensuring high data quality through tests, assertions, evaluations, and robust documentation.

- Commercial Acumen: Ability to understand business needs and communicate effectively with non-technical stakeholders.

- Collaboration: Skilled at working cross functionally and translating complex technical concepts into actionable insights for the business.

- Process-Driven: Proficiency in designing repeatable, scalable workflows for data transformation, including ones that combine automated agents with human oversight.

What you’ll be doing in the role

- Building Data Models: Create complex dbt models, custom macros, and reusable packages. Optimize transformations and implement robust testing strategies to ensure data integrity and model performance.

- Building the Semantic Layer: Design and maintain a semantic layer with well-defined metrics, dimensions, and descriptions so that stakeholders and AI assistants can query company data in natural language and get consistent, accurate answers.

- Introducing Non-Deterministic Transformations: Build and productionise LLM-powered steps within our pipelines, such as categorizing free text or enriching records, with clear evaluation frameworks, cost and latency monitoring, and fallbacks to keep results trustworthy.

- Developing Agentic Workflows: Design and adopt agentic workflows across the analytics engineering lifecycle, including model generation, documentation, test coverage, code review, and incident triage, while defining the guardrails and review processes that keep quality high.

- Ownership: Monitor and maintain dbt workflow jobs, ensuring smooth data refreshes and up-to-date pipelines. You’ll also be responsible for data models powering BI analytics and company-level reporting.

- Ensuring Data Accuracy: Write tests and assertions to validate data integrity and consistency across models, and build evaluation sets to measure the accuracy of natural language and LLM-driven outputs.

- Documenting and Standardising: Create and maintain thorough documentation of dbt processes and semantic definitions, treating metadata as a first-class asset since it directly shapes the quality of AI-generated answers.

- Translating Complex Data Concepts: Act as a key communicator, translating technical data issues into understandable business terms for stakeholders.

- Mentoring Team Members: Support junior analysts and data engineers, especially in setting up experimentation platforms, adopting AI tooling responsibly, and following data best practices.

- Collaborating Across Teams: Work closely with product, engineering, and BI teams to ensure data infrastructure supports evolving business needs, including AI-driven products and internal tools.

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

postings.description:
Director Of AI Research

Location:Based within commutable distance of at least one of our global hubs (London, New York or San Francisco).

 Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

The role

Our AI research team publishes at venues like ICML, ICLR and NeurIPS, works directly with frontier labs on their hardest data and measurement problems, and builds evaluations for public bodies shaping how AI is governed.

Further advances in frontier AI depend on better data and better measurement, and the science of both is still being written. Lead the team that pushes it forward. You'll run a team of research engineers and scientists who build evaluation methods, benchmarks and environments, and forward deployed researchers who work side by side with our closest partners. The team's work ships as artifacts the field requires to push the frontier: benchmarks, evaluations, environments and datasets that labs build on. Your job is to make Prolific a scientific leader in how human signal improves AI, how people and AI work together, and how AI accelerates research. Turn that work into methods, benchmarks and tools that customers use, and independent evidence the field can trust

You'll set the research direction with the team, partner with the product and engineering leaders who take our methods to market, and be Prolific's senior scientific voice with frontier labs, regulators and the research community, working directly with our CEO and executive team. It's a builder's role: a small, strong team, direct access to real, verified people from across the world's population, including leading domain experts, and room to define what good data and evaluation science looks like for the industry. You'll have the compute, budget and tooling to run large human studies and serious model experiments.

Problems You'll Work On

• Pushing model capability with expert data: which experts, which tasks, and how much signal each one adds.
• Agents and environments for training and evaluation, with oversight that scales.
• Safety and how AI affects people (persuasion, perception, reliance), measured with real, representative participants.
• Knowing what moves a model: measuring which data, experts and tasks actually drive capability gains, and why.
• Measurement you can trust: evals, validated judges and human baselines that hold up to saturation and contamination.
• Task and data design that moves a model: signal quality, difficulty and coverage.

What you’ll bring to the role

Research direction

- Own a research strategy aimed at the goals we share with frontier labs: more capable models, safer models, and evidence people can trust. It spans work with lab partners, reusable benchmarks and evals, frontier bets, and public-benefit research.

- Set the scientific bar for the team: rigorous methods and results that hold up to peer review and to scrutiny from frontier labs.

- Make our research the source of what Prolific builds next: reusable methods, benchmarks, tools and new products.

- Build a portfolio of public benchmarks, environments and datasets that become reference points for frontier labs.

- Partner with the leads for each of our product areas, from agents and evaluation to multimodal, safety and specialist domains.

- Protected time for novel and public-benefit research. 

Partnerships and impact

- Be trusted alone in the room with research leaders at frontier labs, and shape our most ambitious research collaborations with them.

- Represent Prolific's science with regulators, safety institutes and academia. Build the partnerships and publications that make us credible.

- Work with product and commercial leads to turn that portfolio into data and evaluations labs adopt and come back for.

- Report research impact to the executive team and board in terms of customers, revenue and scientific standing.

Building the team

- Lead, hire and grow a UK/US team of research engineers, research scientists and forward deployed researchers. Raise the bar with every hire.

- Build a team where strong senior researchers lead their own agendas, and stay close enough to the work to shape the hardest problems yourself.

 What you’ll be doing in the role 

Must-haves

- Research credibility in post-training data, RL environments, AI evaluation, or safety and human-AI interaction. A record frontier lab researchers recognise: papers, benchmarks or methods in use.

- Strong grounding in experimental design and measurement, including with human participants: sampling, validity, reliability, bias.

- 8+ years in research, including 3+ years leading researchers across locations (hiring, managing and growing senior people), ideally in industry or applied settings.

- A track record of turning research into results customers use, including research artifacts others adopted (benchmarks, datasets, environments, tools), not only papers.

- A clear point of view on where data and evaluation for frontier AI are going, the judgement to make hard portfolio calls, and the ability to make that case to executives, customers and the research community.

- Hands-on enough to review a method, read the code and challenge a result.

Nice-to-haves

- Experience at a frontier lab, an AI safety institute, or a human data or evals company.

- A background that spans ML and behavioural or social science (psychology, psychometrics, economics, computational social science).

- Experience building agentic evals or LLM-as-judge pipelines at scale.

- Work with regulators or standards bodies on AI evaluation.

Why Prolific is a great place to work

postings.location: Based within commutable distance of our London or New York hubs.

Director of Operations & Transformation

Location:Based within commutable distance of New York or London.

 Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space—we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that is reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models. 

The role

Prolific connects researchers and companies with people who provide the high-quality human data and feedback that advance research and AI. Our ambition is to become a multi-product company, and we are changing our organisation to support that.
The transition is already under way. We need clearer ownership across teams, faster decisions on priorities and resources, and more reliable delivery against our commitments. You will turn the changes in flight into one practical plan: what changes, in what order, who owns delivery and how we know it is improving performance.
Over 12 months, you will lead implementation and embedding of the new organisational and operating model, and rebuild the planning and execution cycle around our company goals. This includes decision gates, business reviews, clear responsibilities and practical ways of working that teams understand and use.
You will be accountable for the transition programme, its delivery and adoption. The CEO and executive team set strategy and approve material changes to structure, priorities and investment; product and functional leaders own their business outcomes. You will hold leaders to agreed commitments, bring cross-team dependencies and resource conflicts to resolution, and escalate decisions that need executive judgement. You will have executive backing to require clear plans, timely reporting and corrective action when commitments slip.

 What you’ll be doing in the role 

A structured transition to a multi-product company

- Turn the ambition into one integrated transition plan, linking company goals to workstreams, milestones, owners, resources, dependencies and expected benefits. Bring changes already in flight into that plan.

- Sequence delivery around product maturity, customer needs and organisational readiness. Identify gaps in capability, capacity and ownership; work with leaders to resolve them while protecting current customer delivery.

- Maintain a clear view of progress against goals and transition outcomes. Surface risks and trade-offs early, secure decisions and drive recovery plans when delivery falls behind.

Decision gates and evidence

- Agree clear decision rights and proportionate checks with Product, Engineering, Commercial, Finance and People. Let teams make reversible decisions quickly within agreed boundaries. Reserve formal gates for significant investment, customer commitments or changes that are costly to reverse, with clear evidence requirements and a named decision-maker.

- Test readiness using relevant evidence, including customer demand, product readiness, commercial viability, delivery capacity and leadership ownership. Record assumptions, decisions and exceptions, and revisit them as evidence changes. Own the decision process and recommendations; authorised leaders make the decisions.

An operating model that works in practice

- Translate the agreed structure into clear responsibilities, decision rights, handoffs and escalation routes across product lines, functions and shared teams. Document recurring workflows where clarity prevents errors or delays. Keep guidance short, assign an owner and remove steps that no longer serve a purpose.

- Pilot, test and refine new ways of working before extending them. Lead communication, manager guidance and training; check understanding and adoption, gather feedback and fix gaps. Review whether the model improves execution and outcomes.

The company planning and execution cycle

- Make planning lighter and execution faster. Keep teams focused on a small number of clear priorities, with realistic commitments and short feedback loops. Use evidence from customers and delivery to adjust plans quickly. Cut reporting, meetings and forecasting that do not improve decisions or move work forward. Measure success by faster decisions and delivery, with less time spent planning and coordinating.

- Redesign monthly business reviews (MBRs) for the new model and run quarterly Opportunity and Risk reviews. With Finance, Data and functional leaders, establish consistent reporting and capture approved changes to plans, priorities and resources.

- Own the company calendar and business-update rhythm, including all-company meetings. Work closely with the Chief of Staff on CEO priorities, agendas and decision preparation, with clear ownership of each contribution.

Prolific OS and how we work

- Own the business structure, priorities and adoption of Prolific OS with the Data team: where goals, plans, decisions, processes and knowledge live, how they connect and who maintains them across Linear, Notion, Google Workspace and Slack.

- Align Slack channels and information flows to the new model, review them as it evolves and make authoritative information easy to find. Establish a trusted knowledge home and reduce duplicate reporting and manual coordination.

- Use AI and automation to improve these workflows, partnering with Data and technical teams on implementation. Track adoption, usage and cost against measurable productivity gains, service quality and evidenced capacity or headcount impact.

Work in close partnership with the Chief of Staff and directors across the business to coordinate priorities, communication and delivery. Agree one accountable owner for each workstream, hold leaders to commitments and bring unresolved trade-offs to the appropriate executive. Build trust through clear communication, sound judgement and practical follow-through.

What success looks like over 12 months

Agree baselines and targets early for delivery reliability, decision speed and time spent planning, reporting and coordinating. Measure whether teams deliver better outcomes with less overhead, alongside adoption of the new operating model and its business benefits. The expected checkpoints are:

Checkpoint

Expected outcome

First 30 days

An agreed transition plan, baseline, owners and decision gates; a clear view of live changes and immediate risks; a dated handover of relevant interim responsibilities.

By 90 days

The planning and review cycle is running; priority decision flows and SOPs are in use; initial gates are tested; the Prolific OS structure and delivery roadmap are agreed.

Priority changes are embedded and tested; teams use the new reporting and knowledge structure; adoption and benefits are measured, with corrective action where needed.

What you’ll bring to the role

- Strong programme leadership and commercial judgement. You have improved execution in a growing technology business by simplifying planning, shortening decision cycles and resolving cross-team dependencies. You can show where you removed process or reporting—and how performance improved.

- Exceptional communication: explaining change clearly, aligning teams, preparing decision papers and challenging senior leaders constructively. You work credibly across Product, Engineering, Commercial, Finance and People.

- An AI-native, systems-native approach, demonstrated through workflows, integrations or automations you have implemented and measured.
